import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Get qualifying CustomerIDs from transactions
conn = sqlite3.connect('/input/task_180/context/db/transactions_1k.db')
query = "SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE ProductID = 5 AND Price > 29.00"
qualifying_ids = set(pd.read_sql(query, conn)['CustomerID'].tolist())
conn.close()

print(f"Qualifying CustomerIDs count: {len(qualifying_ids)}")
print(f"Sample qualifying IDs: {list(qualifying_ids)[:10]}")

# Load yearmonth.csv
df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_180/context/csv/yearmonth.csv')
print(f"\nYearmonth CSV CustomerID range: {df['CustomerID'].min()} to {df['CustomerID'].max()}")
print(f"Unique CustomerIDs in yearmonth: {df['CustomerID'].nunique()}")

# Check for any overlap
yearmonth_ids = set(df['CustomerID'].astype(int).tolist())
overlap = qualifying_ids.intersection(yearmonth_ids)
print(f"\nOverlap between qualifying IDs and yearmonth IDs: {len(overlap)}")
if overlap:
    print(f"Overlapping IDs: {list(overlap)[:10]}")
